name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering from IIT Madras, focusing on aerodynamics and fluid dynamics. His academic prowess earned him an internship at a local aerospace firm, where he gained hands-on experience with wind tunnel testing.

After graduation, Arjun eagerly sought an opportunity in motorsport, landing a junior role at Caterham Motorsport. He quickly demonstrated a natural aptitude for wind tunnel operations, mastering the intricacies of data acquisition and analysis. His meticulous approach and keen eye for detail have made him an invaluable asset to the team, helping to refine aerodynamic packages for improved performance.

Arjun is driven by a relentless pursuit of knowledge, constantly seeking to expand his understanding of aerodynamics and its impact on race car performance. He believes that a deep understanding of the underlying principles is essential for unlocking new performance gains.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight wave
physical.description: Arjun is of average height and build, with a focused and intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations and sketches.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating on data analysis.
Insists on calibrating the wind tunnel sensors himself before each test run.
